description: This file defines a Sodium class that wraps the libsodium-wrappers-sumo library, providing methods and getters for cryptographic functions, constants, and helpers, and implements the ISodium interface.

classes.name: Sodium
classes.description: A wrapper class for the libsodium-wrappers-sumo library, providing cryptographic functions and constants.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the sodium library by awaiting its readiness.

methods.name: from_base64
methods.description: Converts a base64 string to a Uint8Array, with optional variant.

methods.name: to_base64
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array or string to a base64 string, with optional variant.
